mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 0.5% compresses the risk-free rate, reducing equity discount rates and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days. This mechanism operates continuously without threshold conditions.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of all periods, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate above 0.5% signals monetary tightening, increasing equity discount rates and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days. The signal activates when FEDFUNDS crosses above 0.5%.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 0.5%, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) below their 3-month moving averages indicates a contraction in consumer demand, reducing corporate earnings expectations and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days. The signal requires both series to decline.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline > 0.5% from 3mo_MA, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a high unemployment regime (UNRATE > 6.0%), the Federal Reserve maintains accommodative monetary policy, supporting equity valuations and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days. The mechanism is active only when unemployment exceeds 6.0%.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE > 6.0%, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Strong labor market growth (PAYEMS) indicates robust consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days. This mechanism operates continuously without threshold conditions.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of all periods, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100 signals a manufacturing contraction, reducing corporate profits and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days. The signal activates when INDPRO falls below 100.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO < 100, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1) below 0.5% indicates a broad-based demand slowdown, reducing corporate earnings expectations and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days. The signal requires both series to show negative momentum.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when both HOUST and GDPC1 show negative momentum, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a high inflation regime (CPIAUCSL > 260), the Federal Reserve raises interest rates aggressively, increasing equity discount rates and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days. The mechanism is active only when inflation exceeds 260.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 260, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.
